prerequisites.description: A Google Cloud Project must exist
prerequisites.check: Have you created a GCP project?

prerequisites.description: OAuth consent screen must be configured BEFORE creating credentials
prerequisites.check: Have you configured the OAuth consent screen?

prerequisites.description: Privacy Policy URL required on consent screen
prerequisites.check: Do you have a /privacy page or URL?
prerequisites.if_missing: Create a basic /privacy page — Google requires it

steps.title: Go to Google Cloud Credentials
steps.notes: Make sure you are in the correct GCP project — check project name in the top bar

steps.title: Create OAuth Client ID
steps.notes: If you see a consent screen warning — stop and configure it first

steps.title: Select Web Application
steps.warning: Do NOT select Desktop app or TV — wrong credential type for web

steps.title: Name your OAuth client
steps.instruction: Enter a name — e.g. 'MyApp Web Client'
steps.notes: Internal only — users never see this

steps.title: Add Authorized JavaScript Origins
steps.instruction: Add both your localhost AND production domain
common_mistakes: Including a path — origins must be root domain only
Wrong port — match exactly what your dev server uses

steps.title: Add Authorized Redirect URIs
steps.instruction: Add callback URLs for your auth library
common_mistakes: Wrong callback path for your auth library

steps.title: Click Create
steps.notes: May take up to 5 minutes. Usually instant.

steps.title: Download credentials JSON
steps.instruction: Click 'Download JSON' on the confirmation screen

warnings.message: Configure the OAuth consent screen BEFORE creating credentials or Google will interrupt you mid-flow.
Google now requires a Privacy Policy URL on the consent screen. Have your /privacy URL ready.
Your app is in test mode — maximum 100 users. Submit for Google verification before launch.
Google OAuth verification takes 3-5 business days. Submit at least a week before launch.
Redirect URIs are exact string matches. One wrong character causes redirect_uri_mismatch — hard to debug.

common_errors.cause: Redirect URI in code does not exactly match Google Console
common_errors.fix: Check trailing slashes, http vs https, exact path

common_errors.error: access_blocked: This app's request is invalid
common_errors.fix: Complete OAuth consent screen — add Privacy Policy URL

common_errors.cause: User not in test users list
common_errors.fix: Add email to test users in consent screen settings
